title: Syslog

fields.name: host
fields.description: Domain or IP address of the remote Syslog server.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP or UDP port of the remote Syslog server.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Desired transport type.

fields.name: syslog_format
fields.description: The Syslog protocol format to use.

fields.name: syslog_maxsize
fields.description: The maximum size allowed per message.

fields.name: syslog_severity_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the Syslog severity number.

fields.name: syslog_severity_preset
fields.description: The preset severity number.

fields.name: syslog_facility_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the Syslog facility number.

fields.name: syslog_facility_preset
fields.description: The preset facility number.

fields.name: syslog_hostname_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the hostname that generated the message.

fields.name: syslog_hostname_preset
fields.description: The preset hostname.

fields.name: syslog_appname_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the application name that generated the message.

fields.name: syslog_appname_preset
fields.description: The preset application name.

fields.name: syslog_procid_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the Process ID that generated the message.

fields.name: syslog_procid_preset
fields.description: The preset process ID.

fields.name: syslog_msgid_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the Message ID associated to the message.

fields.name: syslog_msgid_preset
fields.description: The preset message ID.

fields.name: syslog_sd_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains a map of key/value pairs to use as Structured Data (SD) content.

fields.name: syslog_message_key
fields.description: The key name from the original record that contains the message to deliver.

fields.name: allow_longer_sd_id
fields.description: If true, Fluent-bit allows SD-ID that is longer than 32 characters.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Syslog output plugin allows you to deliver messages to Syslog servers.
